architecture.name: Nex-T1 Enterprise AI Agent
architecture.description: Agentic system for cryptocurrency and DeFi operations with Langfuse-backed prompts and HITL execution.

features.name: Multi-Step Reasoning
features.description: Optionally streams a reasoning summary (not chain-of-thought) when supported by the active model/route.

features.name: Dynamic Tool Loading
features.description: Loads tools by intent and environment; optional MCP venue tools for read-only research.

features.name: Smart Caching
features.description: Caches responses based on query, model, and attachments.

features.name: LangFuse Prompt Management
features.description: Dynamic prompt management with versioning and caching for all Nex models.
features.implementation: PromptFactory in src/modules/chat/pipeline/prompt-factory.ts (Langfuse v2 promptsGet + label support)

files.src/app/api/chat/route.ts: Main API endpoint for chat interactions.
files.src/modules/chat/controller.ts: Handles request processing, auth, and rate limiting.
files.src/modules/chat/pipeline.ts: Core logic for model selection, tool config, and execution.
files.src/modules/ai/chatbot/constants.ts: System prompts, model constants, and configuration.
